description: COVID-19 Wastewater Detection - Historical is a dataset listed in City of Chicago open data portal (data.cityofchicago.org), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of Chicago. As described in the function of this dataset was replaced by This dataset is historical-only. Concentrations of the SARS-CoV-2 virus (the COVID-19 virus) gene in the Chicago sewer system, as measured at eight sewershed sites. These sites represent catchment areas that describe wastewater from 319,700 Chicagoans as of January 2023. Coverage: Chicago. The portal files it under the category Health & Human Services. Its tags are testing, public health, historical, health, covid-19. The table has 7 columns. Attribution on the portal: City of Chicago. The portal shows 2025-03-26 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is see the terms of use on the portal (no named licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support wastewater and sewer network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-cityofchicago-org-portal.
